description: April 21 birthday meaning: Aries or Taurus cusp, birthday number 3, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, April 21 is a cusp birthday: depending on the year, time and place of birth, the Sun is in Aries or Taurus. In numerology the day gives birthday number 3, while the Life Path also depends on the birth year. Many people born on cusp dates recognise something of both signs.

sections.heading: Personality of an April 21 birthday
paragraphs: By April 21 the Sun has normally settled about one degree into Taurus, though in an occasional year the Aries side is still possible at birth. Twenty-one reduces to 3, adding charm and expression to the double Venus emphasis of this first decan. The tradition describes an artistic, pleasure-loving and sociable person with a steady centre.

By noon UTC on April 21, the Sun has normally reached roughly 1° of Taurus. That places the date in the Taurus decan that astrologers give to Venus, the first of three. Born around April 19 or 20, you sit near the line between Aries and Taurus, fire giving way to earth. Which sign your Sun actually occupies depends on the birth year, the time of day and the location, because the ingress moment moves slightly from year to year; a natal chart calculated for your details is the only way to be sure. Traditionally, people on this cusp are said to combine Aries' initiative with Taurus' staying power. That can read as determined and practical, or as stubborn twice over, depending on the day.

sections.heading: Numerology of the April 21 birthday
paragraphs: Born on the 21st, your compound reduces as 2 + 1 = 3. Unlike the 12th, where the individual comes first, here the 2 of partnership leads and the 1 follows, which numerologists sometimes read as creativity that grows out of relationships. The resulting 3 is expressive, social and optimistic. Twenty-first-born people are often described as charming and versatile, able to bring people together and make collaborative projects enjoyable. As a supporting number, the 21 tends to show in how easily they connect. Seeing a shared project through to the end can be their most valued contribution.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same April 21 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 7 for 1980, 8 for 1990, 9 for 2000 and 1 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: April 21 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: April birthdays arrive in full northern spring, with lengthening days and fast growth; in the southern hemisphere the month belongs to mid-autumn and harvest. Aries carries most of April, handing over to Taurus around April 19 or 20. As month 4, April brings numerology's number of structure, steadiness and hard work, a grounding counterweight to the quick fire of the month's early birthdays. April 21 is the 111st day of the year (112nd in a leap year). In most years Gemini season is under way by May 21, 30 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for an April 21 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. April 21 is also the birthday of Elizabeth II (1926), Max Weber (1864) and Charlotte Brontë (1816).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is April 21?
faq.answer: April 21 is a cusp date. Between 1930 and 2030 the Sun is in Aries or Taurus on this date depending on the year, the time of birth and the time zone, and in most years at noon UTC it is in Taurus. The zodiac sign calculator settles it for a specific birth date.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on April 21?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On April 21 the Life Path is 5 in 1960, 6 in 1970, 7 in 1980, 8 in 1990, 9 in 2000, 1 in 2010 and 11 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 3 for everyone born on the 21st.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on April 21?
faq.answer: By April 21 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on April 21?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with an April 21 birthday are Elizabeth II (1926), Max Weber (1864) and Charlotte Brontë (1816). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
